'''Tiisheraan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> located in the [[Tiisheraan system/Legends|Tiisheraan system]], a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}. According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], which includes the mission "Taking on Toborro," take place in [[3638 BBY]].</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="RotHC">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Taking on Toborro|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|The Hutt Cartel Alliance}}</ref> and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Artisan/Legends|inventor]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] believed that Tiisheraan would be perfectly suited for hosting a private [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] that<ref name="RotHC" /> he<ref name="Codex" /> wished to have.<ref name="RotHC" />

Tiisheraan was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Galen Derlin]]<ref name="TTTS" /> and the [[Reproduction/Legends|birthplace]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|184|Derlin, Bren}}</ref> his<ref name="CSWE Galen">{{CSWECite|I|185|Derlin, Galen}}</ref> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="FoI">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> son, [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren]].<ref name="CSWE Galen" /> After the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|replaced]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TTTS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> former Senator Derlin returned to Tiisheraan, and was eventually [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by an Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] sent by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TTTS" /> Following<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> his<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Parent/Legends|father's]] death, Bren, as well as his fellow Human native of Tiisheraan, [[Beryann Raleg]], joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="RoguesGallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Perhaps your Supreme Chancellor will reward me with my own private laboratory. The planet Tisheraan ''[sic]'' would be perfect.|Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb, in an optional dialogue with a Galactic Republic-aligned player character|<ref name="RotHC" />}}
[[File:TheLastCommandSourcebook-sm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tiisheraan was created for ''The Last Command Sourcebook''.]]
Tiisheraan was first mentioned in the [[1994]] ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tiisheraan [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Tiisheraan, in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a Galactic Republic&ndash;aligned player character can thank Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb for his assistance in [[Conquest of Makeb|dealing with]] [[Toborro]]&mdash;the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] leader on the planet [[Makeb]]&mdash;at which point Oggurobb expresses the possibility that the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] would reward him by granting him a private laboratory. The Hutt further notes that Tiisheraan&mdash;which the game misspells as "Tisheraan"&mdash;would be a perfect site for such a facility.<ref name="RotHC" />
